data.exact_reserve_text: Calculated from the 'Estimate of cumulative gross claims incurred' table on page 21 by comparing the latest estimate for each underwriting year (2018 and prior) to its estimate from the previous development period.

prior_year_events.impact_description: GBP 3.5m provision for Covid-19 related potential claims for the 2019 pure year of account.

named_events.loss_description: Limited financial impact of Covid-19 claims (GBP 3.5m of Gross and Net provision) for the 2019 pure year of account.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 9.086 million in 2020, primarily driven by adverse claims development across underwriting years 2015 to 2018 as indicated by the claims development triangle. This movement is against a backdrop of general market conditions that included adverse prior year reserve development. The 2019 underwriting year also saw a GBP 3.5 million provision for Covid-19 related claims.
raw_causal_phrases: GBP 3.5m provision for Covid-19 related potential claims

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development calculated from gross claims development triangle on page 21. Narrative text on page 4 provides a net profit/loss attributable to underwriting years, which is a different accounting concept and not used for the gross PYD figure. Percentages for gross premium mix are calculated from the amounts provided in the table.
